name: The Lord of Darkness: The Awakening of the Light
source: In the fascinating world of Eärendil, where magic and mystery intertwine in every corner, "The Awakening of the Light" unfolds, a visual novel that will take you through an epic plot full of adventures, romances and critical decisions. Play Eldarion, a young blacksmith, whose destiny is intertwined with ancient prophecies and ancestral conflicts.
